title: She tried to sell ice to penguins

lines.tts: [intrigued] She tried to sell ice... to penguins.
lines.text: She tried to sell ice... to penguins.

lines.tts: [excited, salesy] Fresh ice! Artisanal ice! Ice with a tiny umbrella!
lines.text: Fresh ice! Artisanal ice! Ice with a tiny umbrella!

lines.tts: [grumpy, flat] Lady. I'm standing on your damn product.
lines.text: Lady. I'm standing on your damn product.

lines.tts: Zero sales. So she made it fancier. Ice sculptures. Premium ice. Ice subscriptions.
lines.text: Zero sales. So she made it fancier. Ice sculptures. Premium ice. Ice subscriptions.

lines.tts: Then Pemmy tried something radical. She asked what their biggest problem was.
lines.text: Then Pemmy tried something radical. She asked what their biggest problem was.

lines.tts: [grumpy] My feet are freezing. Every. Single. Day.
lines.text: My feet are freezing. Every. Single. Day.

lines.tts: Every penguin said the same thing. So she sold tiny wool socks.
lines.text: Every penguin said the same thing. So she sold tiny wool socks.

lines.tts: That's customer discovery. Don't pitch your idea. Ask about their problem.
lines.text: That's customer discovery. Don't pitch your idea. Ask about their problem.
